resources.string: These are validated phone readings and time between nearby readings. They do not measure sleep, wakefulness or sleep stages.
Coverage could not be verified. Original records and files are retained. Check the recording’s file issues; unavailable does not mean zero readings.
Some data is missing or overlaps. Segment values describe only the validated readings below.
Segments overlap within the same boot. Their durations are kept separate and must not be added together.
Original time zone unknown. Times below use UTC.
No validated readings in this segment.
Original sampling request unknown. A supported duration cannot be calculated for this segment.
Other time between first and last reading: %1$s
Missing chunks before or within this segment: %1$d
Readings saved after the last progress checkpoint: %1$d
Pauses, separate segments and time before the first or after the last reading are never counted as covered. Durations are rounded to milliseconds. No whole-night percentage is inferred.
Acquisition provenance was not recorded. Current settings are not substituted.
